## Quick Verdict

OpenProject is a web‑based, open‑source project management tool that offers a free community edition and an enterprise edition, with both self‑hosted and cloud deployment options. It includes native GitHub integration for linking work packages to pull requests. Jira is a commercial issue‑tracking and project‑management platform known for advanced software‑development capabilities and broad corporate adoption. Its free plan supports small teams and emphasizes structured project oversight.

## Side-by-Side Comparison

| Feature | OpenProject | Jira |
|---|---|---|
| Category | Developer Tools | Issue Tracking and Project Management |

## When to Choose OpenProject

- project management
- team collaboration
- GitHub integration

## Strengths of OpenProject

- web-based
- free community edition
- enterprise edition available

Check https://www.openproject.org for current pricing.

## When to Choose Jira

- software development teams
- corporate project management
- small teams using the free tier

## Strengths of Jira

- advanced capabilities for software development projects
- widely adopted in corporate environments
- free plan available for up to 10 users
- provides structured project oversight

## Limitations of Jira

- no information on self-hosting options
- license and pricing details are unknown
- free tier limited to ten users

## Who Should Not Choose Jira

- large teams needing more than ten free users
- organizations requiring open source licensing

Check https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira for current pricing.
